name: Initial Access
desc: getting first access to the cloud account with valid or trusted credentials

name: Execution
desc: running commands or code on cloud instances or serverless functions

name: Persistence
desc: keeping future access by adding credentials, accounts, triggers or images

name: Privilege Escalation
desc: gaining broader permissions by changing policies or assuming stronger roles

name: Stealth
desc: hiding activity by using unusual regions or legitimate-looking accounts

name: Defense Impairment
desc: weakening logging, firewalls, security services or compute safeguards

name: Credential Access
desc: obtaining passwords, secrets, keys or instance credentials

name: Discovery
desc: listing or describing accounts, permissions, resources and security settings

name: Lateral Movement
desc: connecting from the cloud control plane into running instances

name: Collection
desc: gathering stored data from cloud storage before taking it out

name: Exfiltration
desc: moving data or snapshots to an account or network outside the owner's control

name: Impact
desc: deleting, encrypting, stopping or abusing resources at the owner's expense

name: Benign
desc: routine work by authorized operators, pipelines or service roles

name: Valid Accounts
desc: using credentials of an account that already exists

name: Cloud Accounts
desc: signing in or calling APIs with an existing cloud account's credentials
note: new IP or tool needed as context

name: Trusted Relationship
desc: entering through a role trusted by another organization's account

name: Cloud Administration Command
desc: running commands on instances through a cloud management service

name: Serverless Execution
desc: creating or updating serverless functions so they run new code

name: Account Manipulation
desc: changing credentials or permissions of an existing identity

name: Additional Cloud Credentials
desc: issuing new access keys, login passwords or key pairs for an identity
api_hints: CreateAccessKey, CreateLoginProfile, UpdateLoginProfile, GetFederationToken, CreateKeyPair, CreateTrustAnchor

name: Additional Cloud Roles
desc: attaching or adding permission policies to a user or role

name: SSH Authorized Keys
desc: adding ssh public keys that allow later logins to instances

name: Create Account
desc: creating a new identity in the account

name: Cloud Account
desc: creating a new IAM user identity

name: Event Triggered Execution
desc: creating rules or triggers that run code automatically on events

name: Implant Internal Image
desc: pushing a modified container or machine image to a registry

name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
desc: using built-in mechanisms that grant higher privileges temporarily

name: Temporary Elevated Cloud Access
desc: assuming a more privileged role or passing a role to a service

name: Unused/Unsupported Cloud Regions
desc: creating or running resources in regions the account does not normally use
api_hints: RunInstances etc. in an unusual awsRegion

name: Disable or Modify Tools
desc: turning off or changing logging and security tools

name: Disable or Modify Cloud Log
desc: stopping, deleting or narrowing cloud audit and network logging
api_hints: StopLogging, DeleteTrail, UpdateTrail, PutEventSelectors, DeleteFlowLogs, DeleteResolverQueryLogConfig

name: Disable Security Services
desc: disabling or reconfiguring cloud threat detection and security services
note: v19 merged T1562.001 into parent T1685; custom leaf id

name: Disable or Modify System Firewall
desc: changing firewall rules to allow traffic that was blocked

name: Cloud Firewall
desc: opening security groups or network ACLs to wide network access

name: Modify Cloud Compute Infrastructure
desc: creating, deleting or changing compute resources to avoid defenses

name: Create Snapshot
desc: creating snapshots of volumes or databases

name: Create Cloud Instance
desc: launching new compute instances

name: Delete Cloud Instance
desc: terminating compute instances

name: Revert Cloud Instance
desc: restoring instances from snapshots to erase changes

name: Modify Cloud Compute Configurations
desc: changing account-level compute settings such as quotas

name: Modify Cloud Resource Hierarchy
desc: leaving or changing the cloud organization or account structure

name: Brute Force
desc: trying many passwords until a sign-in succeeds

name: Password Spraying
desc: trying a few common passwords against many accounts

name: Credential Stuffing
desc: trying leaked username and password pairs
note: hard to tell from T1110.003 in CloudTrail

name: Credentials from Password Stores
desc: reading credentials kept in a password or secrets store

name: Cloud Secrets Management Stores
desc: retrieving many secrets or decrypted parameters from a secrets store

name: Unsecured Credentials
desc: finding credentials stored in insecure places

name: Cloud Instance Metadata API
desc: using instance role credentials taken from the metadata service
api_hints: API calls with an instance role from an outside IP

name: Credentials in Instance Settings
desc: reading passwords or secrets stored in instance settings
note: parent T1552; no single v19 sub-technique fits

name: Steal Application Access Token
desc: obtaining application tokens to act as that application

name: Forge Web Credentials
desc: creating credentials that let the attacker sign in as others

name: SAML Tokens
desc: adding or changing SAML providers to forge sign-ins

name: Account Discovery
desc: listing accounts that exist

name: Cloud Account
desc: listing IAM users, roles and their details

name: Cloud Infrastructure Discovery
desc: describing instances, volumes, snapshots and networks

name: Cloud Service Discovery
desc: enumerating which cloud services are in use across the account

name: Cloud Storage Object Discovery
desc: listing objects inside storage buckets

name: Log Enumeration
desc: reading audit log settings or searching past events

name: Permission Groups Discovery
desc: finding groups and permissions assigned to identities

name: Cloud Groups
desc: listing groups and policies attached to identities

name: Password Policy Discovery
desc: reading the account password policy

name: Software Discovery
desc: checking which software and services are installed or enabled

name: Security Software Discovery
desc: checking which security services are enabled

name: Remote Services
desc: logging in to systems through remote access services

name: Direct Cloud VM Connections
desc: connecting to instances through cloud remote access services

name: Data from Cloud Storage
desc: reading many objects from storage buckets

name: Data Staged
desc: copying data to one place before taking it out

name: Transfer Data to Cloud Account
desc: sharing snapshots, images or buckets with an external account

name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
desc: opening a network path to move data outside
note: the transfer itself is not in CloudTrail

name: Account Access Removal
desc: deleting or changing credentials so owners lose access

name: Data Destruction
desc: destroying stored data or resources

name: Delete Data or Resources
desc: deleting buckets, objects, databases or machine images
note: parent T1485; object deletion needs data events

name: Lifecycle-Triggered Deletion
desc: setting storage lifecycle rules that delete data

name: Data Encrypted for Impact
desc: re-encrypting stored data with a key the owner does not control
api_hints: PutObject with customer key, kms key changes

name: Inhibit System Recovery
desc: deleting snapshots and backups needed for recovery

name: Resource Hijacking
desc: using the owner's resources for the attacker's benefit

name: Compute Hijacking
desc: launching many or large instances for the attacker's workloads

name: Cloud Service Hijacking
desc: calling paid cloud services such as AI models or email at scale

name: Service Stop
desc: stopping or deleting running services

name: Benign Deployment
desc: building, pushing or rolling out software through an authorized pipeline

name: Benign Monitoring
desc: routine checks, listing or describing resources by operators or tools

name: Benign Automation
desc: scheduled jobs and service roles doing their configured tasks

name: Benign Operations
desc: operators scaling, maintaining or configuring resources as planned
